definitions.explanation: The process of replacing stale indoor air with fresh outdoor air to maintain air quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧{換気|かんき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please open the window and ventilate.

examples.japanese: {換気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|よご}れる→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。
examples.english: The air gets stale if ventilation is poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{換気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Regular ventilation is important for infection prevention.

notes:
COVID-19 CONTEXT: {換気|かんき} became a frequently used word during the COVID-19 pandemic as proper ventilation was emphasized as a key preventive measure.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{換気|かんき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {換気|かんき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to ventilate)
- {換気|かんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ventilation)
- {換気|かんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/poor ventilation)

- {換気|かんき}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧ (ventilation system)
